body:
## Summary

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#105.

Adds preset management to the example/Electron app:
- fixed left preset sidebar with save, per-preset load buttons, sidebar-only scrolling, and settings button
- first-save modal with numeric default name, preset folder field, folder chooser, and "Don't show again"
- localStorage-backed preset list for browser usage
- Electron folder picker and JSON preset export through preload/main IPC
- preset loading that reapplies full app settings, visualizer options, audio enhancement, video dimensions, colors, background data, preview state, and alignment guides

Also adds the requested case-study materials under `docs/case-studies/issue-105` with captured issue/PR data and implementation analysis.

## Merge Conflict Resolution

Merged the latest `upstream/main` into `issue-105-fa7c67075e3f` and resolved the conflict in `examples/app-core.js` by preserving both:
- issue 105 preset save/load helpers
- upstream preview alignment guide behavior from issue 99

## Reproduction / Verification

Before this change there was no preset sidebar, no preset modal, and no way to save or reload complete visualization settings as named presets.

Automated coverage added:
- `cypress/e2e/preset-management.cy.js` verifies saving a preset, default numeric names, localStorage persistence, sidebar load buttons, restoring settings, and skip-dialog mode.
- `cypress/e2e/preview-alignment-guides.cy.js` remains passing after the merge and verifies the upstream preview guide behavior preserved during conflict resolution.

Local checks run:
- `npm test`
- `npm run build`
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/preset-management.cy.js`
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/preview-alignment-guides.cy.js`
